PART I

Item 4. Information on the Company

A. History and Development of the Company

Synthetic Mining plc was incorporated in England and Wales in 1899; its American Depositary Shares have been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 1990.

B. Business Overview

Our business

Synthetic Mining plc explores for, mines and processes iron ore, copper and aluminium, and sells them to steelmakers, smelters and manufacturers in Asia, Europe and the Americas.

Item 4

The Group operates 17 mines in six countries; iron ore from its Pilbara operations provides most of its revenue.
